Actions.Text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO HIGHER EDUCATION

Title: Establishes the removing barriers to higher education success act
Summary: Establishes the "removing barriers to higher education success act" which directs the state university and city university to adopt policies that makes certain documentation submitted by an enrolled or admitted student sufficient to establish that such student is an individual with a disability; establishes a program to provide transition services for students with disabilities entering higher education.
ActClause: AN ACT establishing the "removing barriers to higher education success act"
